title: Interior smoke developed index requirements based on occupancy group.
officialText:
Except where permitted for interior trim in Section 806.5, acceptable smoke-developed indices shall range from 0-450 with the following restrictions:

Exits, corridors 25 or less Occupancy Group I 50 or less

Rooms in which the net

floor area per occupant is 10

square feet or less 100 or less
